title.narrative: Harmonized or unified Bangladesh Qualification Framework (BNQF) structure is finalized and endorsed

description.narrative: Harmonized or unified Bangladesh Qualification Framework (BNQF) structure is finalized and endorsed

comment.narrative: National Technical Vocational Qualification Framework is there as per NSDP 2011. Based on this the BNQF is to be developed. And this this is totally an new concept in Bangladesh. In 2018 project conducted a study on Assessment of the National Technical and Vocational Qualifications Framework and roadmap for development of the Bangladesh Qualifications Framework which includes the baseline information on BNQF.Although the project started in 2017 but the project could start its implementation activity as well as needs assessment and baseline studiesreview from 1 January 2018 from the month it received the Government approval.

The BNQF have been approved. But its adoption may take time as it is a national level issue where all sectors for education will be there to implement BNQF.BNQF officially launched in March 2023The NQAS and Implementation Manual for the HE TVET and Skills sector have been approved by NSC for implementationThe accreditation manual for higher education was adopted by universities under the BNQF frameworkThe national curriculum of general education now includes a chapter on lifelong learning and pathways to vocational education The national curriculum of general education includes vocational skills in chapters on care giving tourism agricultureBNQF policy document developed and Approved by the Ministry of Education. The draft BNQF policy sent to Cabinet for formal approval

The activitys duration has been extended till June 30 2024. Despite the approval and launch of BNQF in 2021 and 2023 respectively further steps are necessary for its successful implementation. This includes finalizing and gaining endorsement from the ministry for other essential documents like the quality assurance manual implementation guidelines and draft legislation. A recent BNQF NSC meeting was conducted by the project resulting in agreement and guidance to proceed with finalizing and submitting the NQAS manual implementation guidelines and draft legislation to TMED.
